entities.summary: Yule Mervyn Charles McCann was a naturalist in India and New Zealand. He wrote a popular book on the trees of India and edited a major regional flora apart from publishing many of his other observations, mainly in the journal of the Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS) that he was associated with. He contributed to studies of New Zealand's whales, seals, skinks and geckos.
